universities.summary: Meenakshi Academy of Higher Education and Research, MAHER, is a private deemed-to-be university headquartered in West K.K. Nagar, Chennai. Its constituent colleges operate in Chennai and Kanchipuram, with programmes in medicine, rehabilitation, allied health, arts, commerce, computing and Yoga. Choose the exact college and award when comparing entry routes and fees.
universities.campusLifestyle: MAHER’s constituent colleges have separate teaching locations and academic environments. Arts, science, rehabilitation and Yoga programmes are described at West K.K. Nagar, while the medical and allied-health campus is at Enathur near Kanchipuram. Confirm the reporting location, timetable and practical requirements for the exact programme.
universities.cityProfile: The university office is at 12 Vembuliamman Koil Street, West K.K. Nagar, Chennai 600078. Meenakshi Medical College Hospital and Research Institute is at Enathur, Kanchipuram 631552. These locations are separate travel and accommodation choices; an offer for one college should not be treated as study at every MAHER campus.
universities.practicalExposure: Medical programmes use the constituent hospital setting and prescribed clinical training. Allied-health degrees list three academic years plus an internship year, while rehabilitation master’s degrees build on completed professional undergraduate preparation. Arts, commerce and computing use their own curricula and projects. Practical exposure varies by course and does not guarantee professional registration, an external placement or employment.
universities.hostelOverview: MAHER’s prospectus describes residential provision, but allocation and charges depend on the constituent college. The medical tuition table explicitly excludes hostel, room rent and mess. Confirm the actual residence, current availability, deposits, meals and refund conditions before making a separate accommodation payment.
universities.dietarySupport: Ask the relevant constituent residential office about meal provision and any dietary needs before accepting accommodation. Academic tuition does not establish an included meal plan or a guaranteed special-diet service.
universities.safetyOverview: The university and constituent websites publish anti-ragging, student grievance and internal-complaints resources. Keep the reporting contacts for the actual college and residence available; published procedures do not establish a general safety guarantee.
universities.studentSupport: Applicants use the university admission office for programme and qualification checks. Medical degree admission follows the applicable NEET and MCC counselling route. Rehabilitation master’s applicants must satisfy their professional-degree and eligibility requirements; keep originals and category records ready for verification.

faq.question: Which Meenakshi institution is this?
faq.answer: This is Meenakshi Academy of Higher Education and Research, MAHER, with constituent colleges in Chennai and Kanchipuram. It is distinct from Meenakshi College for Women and separately affiliated similarly named colleges.

faq.question: Are all programmes taught at one campus?
faq.answer: No. Check the programme’s constituent college and actual teaching location. The Enathur medical campus near Kanchipuram is separate from West K.K. Nagar and other Chennai teaching sites.

faq.question: How are medical students admitted?
faq.answer: The verified route uses the applicable NEET qualification and MCC deemed-university counselling allotment, followed by original-document, eligibility and seat-category checks.

faq.question: What do MPT and MOT applicants need?
faq.answer: The current MEET-PG notice specifies two-year MPT and MOT programmes and 50% in BPT or BOT respectively. The applicable college also checks the recognised full-time qualifying degree and required internship or university eligibility records.

faq.question: Are MCAS programmes only for women?
faq.answer: The currently linked 2025–26 prospectus identifies Shift I for women and Shift II for women and men, with different award availability. Check the exact programme’s shift restriction and confirm current allocation before acceptance.

faq.question: What language is used?
faq.answer: The MCAS programme page specifies English instruction; exact Tamil-subject language arrangements remain unconfirmed here. Other programme language fields are left blank where independent programme evidence was unavailable.

faq.question: What does the fee cover?
faq.answer: Medical-campus figures are published annual tuition. Where other colleges publish semester tuition, the native semester amount is quoted separately without multiplying it into annual tuition. Hostel, mess and other charges require separate confirmation.

faq.question: Can international or NRI applicants use these amounts?
faq.answer: These records describe verified domestic regular routes. NRI or foreign qualification, counselling category and overseas fees require separate assessment; a standard INR tariff is not a universal overseas quote.
